races.paceDynamic: Port Darwin and Sir Griflet will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid but not frantic gallop over this 1m4f trip. Miss Mambo and Grindleton should sit prominent behind the leaders, while the four hold-up horses (Goldfinder, Kakirra, Risk Averse Rebel, Make It Up) will track from midfield to rear. The sustained pace over 1m4f combined with only two dedicated pace-setters creates an honest tempo that should suit prominent racers and strong finishers who can position close enough to strike. This race shape favours horses with tactical speed who can sit handy rather than pure front-runners or deep closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves steady but honest with Port Darwin and Sir Griflet sharing early duties
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the leaders while the hold-up horses find themselves too far back on the long home straight. Grindleton and Miss Mambo benefit from perfect positioning to pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to soften up the leaders in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: Kakirra's recent winning form tells as he sweeps past tiring front-runners, with other hold-up horses also getting competitive. The hat-trick seeker proves his class rise is justified.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Port Darwin or Sir Griflet establish an uncontested lead and maintain kick for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows one leader to control the tempo and find extra when challenged. Port Darwin's stamina breeding could prove decisive despite recent poor form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Advantage Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true test of stamina where the weight differentials matter most
scenarios.body: Make It Up and Risk Averse Rebel benefit from their significant weight advantages in a gruelling finish. The 14lb pull that Make It Up enjoys over the top weights becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Port Darwin and Sir Griflet must be watched early as their duel will set the tempo for the entire race outcome
Make It Up carries a fading warning but enjoys a 14lb weight advantage that could neutralise stamina concerns late
Kakirra faces a 13lb rise after two wins but Billy Loughnane's retention suggests confidence in handling the penalty
Miss Mambo steps up significantly in trip on Tapeta debut with only modest form to recommend her
Grindleton makes Tapeta debut with Oisin Murphy booked, suggesting connections expect the surface switch to suit

races.paceDynamic: Diligent Henry is the only confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate the tempo without pressure from the break. With nine hold-up horses behind him, this creates a sustainable early pace that will build gradually through the middle sections. The lack of pace pressure means Diligent Henry can conserve energy early, while the hold-up brigade will be bunched together turning for home. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader closely and horses with proven finishing speed who can quicken from the pack.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Diligent Henry gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a sustained drive, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back. His C&D winning experience becomes crucial in a race that develops into a staying test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the sustainable pace sets up perfectly for a closer with turn of foot
scenarios.body: The bunched field turning in creates traffic problems, but one hold-up horse gets a clean run and superior finishing speed. Mintana's recent Lingfield win shows she has the class edge when getting the right race shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If Sanditon or Star Of Atlantis moves up early to apply pressure
scenarios.body: The pace quickens through the middle sections, testing Diligent Henry's stamina reserves and creating a more even contest. This benefits horses who can travel strongly in behind without needing a sustained kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Diligent Henry goes too slow and the field bunches into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early gallop means superior class tells rather than tactical positioning. Form horses with any finishing speed will dominate the final furlong shuffle.

watchPoints.text: Diligent Henry could steal this if allowed completely uncontested lead given the lack of other pace
Traffic problems likely for hold-up horses with nine needing room - watch for clear runs in straight
Mintana's finishing kick could be decisive if the pace sets up right given her recent Lingfield success
Several horses showing fading tendencies including Pacific Prince, Morning Suit and Green Valentine
First-time headgear changes on Mister McGregor and Petes Diamond suggest trainer concerns about effort levels

races.paceDynamic: Filey Beach will take the field along from the start as the only confirmed front runner, with Bungle Bay likely to settle in second tracking the pace. With nine hold-up horses and just one prominent runner, this shapes as a moderate gallop through the early stages before quickening from halfway. The lack of pace pressure means Filey Beach can dictate comfortable fractions, while the hold-up brigade including Dr Ali, Vitalline, and Telling Time will be relying on a strong finish. This tactical setup clearly favours the early-positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Filey Beach sets uncontested fractions and Bungle Bay tracks into contention
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leaders to kick clear when the field starts to close, leaving the hold-up horses with too much ground to make up in the straight. Filey Beach's recent turf form and Bungle Bay's course specialisation prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The condensed field creates opportunities for the better finishers to unleash their kicks, with Dr Ali's 6f speed or Vitalline's AW experience coming to the fore. Traffic becomes less of an issue with better positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Telling Time Peaks
scenarios.trigger: If the 3-year-old gets first run on his rivals from an ideal tracking position
scenarios.body: His weight allowance and previous course form over 6f-7f translates effectively, while many rivals struggle to get competitive positions from their hold-up styles. The drop to this level proves key.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If severe congestion in the straight allows an unconsidered outsider to find a clear passage
scenarios.body: The packed field creates a lottery finish where positioning matters more than ability, potentially suiting Miss Moonshine or Angel's Call if they get the right breaks. Pure chance determines the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Filey Beach must translate recent turf form to AW surface where he's winless in six attempts
Watch for traffic congestion in the straight with nine hold-up horses needing room to manoeuvre
Bungle Bay needs to secure the ideal tracking position behind Filey Beach early in the race
Dr Ali's wide draw in stall 10 could force him to use energy getting across from his hold-up style
Monitor whether Vitalline can overcome his habitual slow starts given the likely steady early pace

races.paceDynamic: Mr Noble is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will be allowed to dictate terms from the outset at a sustainable gallop. Several prominent runners including Rumble Ruby, Celtic Chariot, and Luckie Lucas will track him in the early stages, but none have shown the pace or inclination to challenge for the lead. The lack of pace pressure means Mr Noble can control fractions and kick clear when ready. This tactical setup strongly favors horses with early speed and those who can position prominently, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from the back of a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Noble gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The proven winner controls the race from pillar to post and has too much in reserve for his inexperienced rivals. His class edge from that Newcastle victory becomes decisive when he's not under pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenger Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking horses can sustain a challenge to Mr Noble
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuine enough to set up the race for a horse with tactical speed but the stamina to outstay the leader. Celtic Chariot or Manly Fireball benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Navertity Impresses
scenarios.trigger: If Navertity shows the ability suggested by his breeding and connections
scenarios.body: The Oisin Murphy/Harry Charlton combination often produce smart newcomers first time out, and the moderate pace allows class to tell. His dam's Group 3 form suggests he could be well above this level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The lack of pace turns this into a pure speed test over the final 2f, allowing a finisher to pick up the pieces. Cool Doc Boy or Manly Fireball could benefit if they get the right racing room.

watchPoints.text: Mr Noble could get such an easy lead that he becomes unbeatable if his fitness holds after 194 days off
Navertity represents unknown quantity with Oisin Murphy booked and could be anything on debut
The lack of pace could turn this into a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot could strike
Manly Fireball needs the leaders to go quick enough to set up his finishing kick from the rear
Several horses including Rumble Ruby and Luckie Lucas have shown tendency to fade in the closing stages

races.paceDynamic: Rogers Dream is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will lead unchallenged through the early stages over the extended 1m2f trip. With most of the field showing hold-up tendencies, there will be minimal early pressure allowing Rogers Dream to dictate a steady gallop. The lack of prominent racers means a bunched field turning for home with the majority needing room and racing luck from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours horses that can track the pace in the first half of the field, as the hold-up brigade will face traffic problems in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Rogers Dream maintains a steady gallop and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the front runner to kick clear turning for home while the field gets bunched up behind. Late closers struggle to make up the ground despite Rogers Dream's stamina limitations.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and prominent runners get first run on the field.
scenarios.body: Knightmare and Lady Aiyana track Rogers Dream perfectly positioned to strike with 2f out while the hold-up horses are still navigating traffic. The extended trip suits their racing style better than pure speed horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps appear for hold-up horses in the straight.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a sprint finish where class tells and the better handicapped horses can unleash sustained challenges. Sorted and Lady Of Clover benefit from their C&D experience.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race fragments due to the uneven pace distribution and a big-priced runner finds clear water.
scenarios.body: The tactical nature of the contest allows an unfancied runner to steal a march while the fancied horses are marking each other. Market leaders get caught flat-footed by an improving type.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Vanguard stands alone as the confirmed front runner, meaning she can dictate a sustainable tempo without early pressure from rivals. The prominent runners Amazing Anita and City Of Dreams will sit just off the pace, while the field is overwhelmingly weighted towards hold-up horses including Zoulette, Veld, and South Coast Star. With minimal early speed and a single leader controlling things, this sets up perfectly for horses that can settle and finish strongly. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers and patient rides over early speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Vanguard gets easy fractions and stays the trip
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls every call with soft splits, allowing her to kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising their runs. Blinkers help her settle and the lack of pace pressure plays directly into her hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and suits closers
scenarios.body: The slow tempo allows the best hold-up horse to unleash a devastating finish from the back, with Zoulette's recent Leicester second highlighting her progressive profile. South Coast Star's course form also makes her dangerous in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Amazing Anita uses her tactical speed from her handy position
scenarios.body: The recent stable transfer gets the jump on both the uncontested leader and the struggling hold-up horses, using her prominence to strike at the perfect moment. Her course second form gives her a clear edge over most of these rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Vanguard fails to handle the responsibility of leading
scenarios.body: The field crawls early then bunches into a messy sprint where anything can happen, potentially suiting horses with tactical speed. This chaotic finish could favour any horse getting a clear run at the right moment.

races.paceDynamic: Dusk Damsel looks the only confirmed early leader in this field, with prominent runners Labiche, Based, and Warriors Choice likely to track her. The majority of the field (Musical Soldier, Power Of Chora, Electrocution, Ndoto, Inclusive) are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop. With limited early pace pressure, Dusk Damsel can dictate a steady tempo that may not provide enough galloping room for the large contingent of closers. This tactical setup strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics over hold-up horses who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Dusk Damsel gets an uncontested lead and controls the tempo
scenarios.body: She can quicken off steady fractions while the hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed behind a moderate pace. The prominent trackers Based and Labiche get first run on the field when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Speed
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes very slow with minimal pressure on Dusk Damsel
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where natural speed horses and those positioned handy have decisive advantages. Hold-up horses find no gaps or acceleration late against the positioned runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Based and Labiche put genuine pressure on Dusk Damsel through mid-race
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up perfectly for the strong-travelling hold-up horses to produce their finishing kicks. Musical Soldier and Electrocution find the gaps and galloping room they need late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Stalker
scenarios.trigger: If Warriors Choice or Labiche challenge Dusk Damsel early creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The early battle softens up the leaders while creating ideal conditions for a horse tracking just behind. Based gets the perfect trip stalking the pace battle before striking late.

races.paceDynamic: Age Of Time is the sole confirmed front runner and will control the early pace from the gates. With no pressure from other pace horses, she'll dictate comfortable fractions through the first mile before the field bunches up for the final 1½ furlongs. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Study Up, City Escape, Silkies Sib, and Roman Secret will be tracking behind, waiting to pounce in the straight. This tactical setup strongly favours closers who can deliver late kicks, as the uncontested leader may struggle to sustain her effort when the field unleashes in the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time faces no early pressure and conserves energy through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: She'll have enough left in the tank to resist late challenges, particularly with her proven course form and recent consistency off this mark. Front runners often benefit when they can dictate their own tempo without harassment.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady early allowing closers to stay within striking distance
scenarios.body: The wall of hold-up horses will swamp Age Of Time in the final furlong when she begins to tire from her solo effort. Study Up's recent Leicester win shows his finishing kick is sharp, while Silkies Sib has excellent course form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time goes too slowly early and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical position matters more than stamina, potentially suiting the prominent runners. Shaws Phoenix could benefit from being closer to the pace when the dash begins.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If the main fancied closers get caught in traffic or fail to fire
scenarios.body: A less fancied hold-up horse like Beachborough Girl or City Escape could emerge from the pack with a clear run. Both have shown consistency at this level and could benefit if the market leaders disappoint.
